about_the_game:
Stadium Alpha features 120+ Dynamic Arenas showcasing 60 real larger than life North American cities!

(European expansion coming soon in Beta!)

Endless bracket tournaments!

Win 5 epic rounds of Hockey or Basketball single elimination tournaments to earn Championship trophies for your office and Title Banners to hang in your stadium for every tournament you win!

Its Game Time.

The deck is shuffled, your hand is dealt, high card wins.. Just make sure you know what else your cards and suits can do. Luck and skill play their part as you make your way through intense turn-based action with a standard deck of 54 cards! Each game takes about 10 min and the scores are ultra-realistic! Trading Card Rosters: Your hockey or basketball team is composed of Stadium Trading cards, they collect stats as you play. As you level up, you can earn new skins and custom features for them!

Pick your Sport. Join your City. Win the Championship!


DEEP ROSTER TRACKING
Over 1,400 unique Trading Cards Endless Stat Tracking for Goals, Assists, PPG, Steals, Blocks and Rebounds!

Ultra-Competitive AI to keep you on your toes! (Multiplayer coming in Beta!)

name: Stadium
short_description: Welcome to Stadium. The Original Game Changer. Pick your Sport, Lead your City, Win a Championship, Build a Dynasty, Leave a Legacy. You play the games, you make the calls. Bring your cards to life. Stadium is a brand new strategy game system unlike anything you've played before.
